title: Kaitlan Collins SMACKS DOWN Elise Stefanik’s Deflection LIVE
description:
When a New York congresswoman sat down with Kaitlan Collins on CNN, what followed was one of the more revealing cable news interviews of the year. This video breaks down the full exchange between Congresswoman Elise Stefanik and CNN anchor Kaitlan Collins, a back and forth that turned into a masterclass in how political talking points hold up the moment someone actually pushes back on them.

The conversation was set against the backdrop of two overlapping legal stories dominating the news cycle at the time. A special counsel had just released a report on the sitting president's handling of classified documents, recommending no charges, while the former president faced his own separate classified documents case. Stefanik arrived with a clear argument that the justice system was being weaponized for political reasons. Collins pressed on nearly every claim, and the result is a tense, fast moving interview where the questions matter as much as the answers.

In my reaction and commentary, I walk through why the weaponization argument runs into trouble almost immediately, how the phrase selective prosecution quietly concedes more than it defends, and what happens when a claim about legal authority meets an interviewer who has actually read the law being cited. I also break down the moment the conversation shifts to whether Stefanik is auditioning for a vice presidential role, the surprising answer she gives about how she would have handled a key constitutional moment, and the pivot
